summary.text: In June 2023, Navarro described a frightening and dangerous AI future and said AI was about to destroy jobs and kill people. In February 2024, he described China as intending to use AI for military purposes and accused Nvidia of selling bootleg AI chips to China. In June 2026, he described an AI-enabled border tool as helping detect fraud before illicit goods reached American markets.
